messages:
jonathan: Hey team, getting multiple customer reports of 502s from hosted API during streaming responses. Started ~08:04 UTC, small spike but persistent for a few tenants. sample curl shows immediate reset on chunked response trailers. anyone seen trailer-related issues lately?

maria: I noticed an Envoy error in eu1 around that time: "connection error: downstream reset while forwarding upstream response". TL;DR looks like proxy choking when downstream sends chunked trailers.

sam: Can you paste the raw curl and envoy log?

jonathan: sure — here's a minimal repro we used from customer: 

curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.hosted.redwood.ai/v1/streams/generate?model=gpt-open-16k" \n  -d $'{"prompt":"hello","stream":true}' 

Response partial: 
---
HTTP/2 200
content-type: application/json
transfer-encoding: chunked

{"id":"...","choices":[{"delta":{"text":"Hel"}}]}

...data chunks...

0
Trailer-Header: some-val
\r\n
(read ends, client sees 502)
---

ops-bot: @channel envoy@eu1 reported: upstream response body truncated (code=10) at 2026-03-18T08:04:12Z

maria: The trailer lines look suspicious — trailing CRLF vs CRLF-CRLF could confuse the ingress, or the upstream (runtime) is emitting an extra \r before final chunk. Envoy sometimes treats malformed chunked trailers as protocol violation and returns 502.

leo: We rolled an ingress filter change yesterday to tighten header parsing (reduce buffer for trailing metadata). Could be related. I have the rollout id: canary-2026-03-17-19:22.

sam: If that config started restricting trailer parsing, streaming models that attach model metadata as trailers could be affected. Workaround: disable trailer stripping in ingress or fallback to sending metadata in body.

jonathan: Customer provided trace id 01-abcde-xyz; sample backend logs show: 
[upstream/runtime] INFO 08:04:11 request id=01-abcde-xyz response-chunks=34 trailers={metadata: "len=324"}
[envoy/ingress] ERROR 08:04:12 connection_reset_by_peer while flushing downstream (protocol-violation) trace=01-abcde-xyz

maria: Repro steps I ran locally (eu1 replica): 
1) curl stream (same as above)
2) send final chunk then single-line trailer with CRLF only
3) observe envoy logs: "http2: protocol error: invalid final field" -> 502 to client

leo: I'm going to temporarily rollback that header-parsing tighten on the canary and expand the trailer buffer to 16k. Rolling now.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback canary-2026-03-17-19:22 initiated by leo at 08:12 UTC

sam: Good. Longer-term we should: 
- Add a fallback in runtime: if trailer write fails, emit metadata as a final JSON block in body and close gracefully.
- Add a test in ingress e2e for chunked trailers from upstream (simulate both correct and slightly malformed trailers).

jonathan: Customers asking for immediate mitigation steps — I'm telling them: use non-streaming or include metadata in body for now, and we're prioritizing fix.

maria: I also pulled metrics: 502 rate for streaming endpoints in eu1 jumped from 0.03% -> 1.8% between 08:03-08:15 UTC. No increase in CPU or upstream error codes. Points to ingress-level rejection.

leo: Rollback completed on canary; canary telemetry shows 502s dropping back down. Will propagate to stable after 15m if no regression.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary-2026-03-17-19:22 rollback COMPLETED at 08:17 UTC

jonathan: Thanks. I'll update the customers and document repro steps in support KB. Sam, can you open a runtime/story to add body-fallback for trailers and an ingress e2e test?

sam: On it. Creating ticket INF-2187 with steps & priority P1.

leo: Also patching ingress config test to allow the slightly malformed CRLF variant to be accepted (safe-parsing mode).

jonathan: Perfect. I'll mark this thread resolved once INF-2187 and the canary-to-stable push are green. :thumbsup: 

maria: Follow-up: list of affected tenants (from support): tenant-a, tenant-c, tenant-embeds. I'll DM details to jonathan.

jonathan: Received. Closing customer escalations after we confirm stable rollout.

sam: INF-2187: https://redwood.internal/INF-2187 (added repro script + curl samples)

leo: FYI we should add monitoring alert for sudden trailer-related 502 spikes (ingress.http2.trailer_protocol_errors).

jonathan: good call. creating alert ticket now.

ops-bot: alert-bot created incident incident-20260318-08:05 for ingress.http2.trailer_protocol_errors

jonathan: thanks all — threading into KB and follow-ups.
